result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the top-right profile/avatar control appears broken: it renders as an empty gray circle with a stray red dot and no icon or image. Secondary issues include low-contrast search placeholder text and inconsistent card imagery in the 'Fastest near you' row.

issues.description: The circular profile/account button in the top-right header is empty — a plain light-gray circle with no avatar image, initials, or person icon. It reads as a failed image load or missing asset rather than an intentional control.
issues.suggestion: Render a fallback avatar (user photo, initials, or a generic person icon) inside the circle so the control is recognizable and tappable-looking even when no profile image is available.

issues.description: The small red notification dot sits loosely inside the upper-right area of the empty avatar circle instead of being anchored to the circle's edge, making it look like a stray artifact rather than a badge.
issues.suggestion: Position the notification badge absolutely at the top-right edge of the avatar (partially overlapping the border) with a white outline ring, and only show it when there is an actual notification.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving weak contrast that may be hard to read in bright conditions.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (or lighten the field background) to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against the input fill.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the first card (Green Bowl Poké) uses a flat illustration on a plain light background while the neighboring cards use dark photographic imagery, creating an inconsistent visual rhythm in the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card imagery (consistent photo treatment, background tone, and crop/aspect ratio) or apply a uniform fallback style for restaurants without photos.
